caption: The drawing features a wooden cabinet with a rounded top and a small ornamental detail at its peak that resembles a crown or flame, positioned in the upper center of the image. The cabinet is rendered in brown and light tan tones, and the front has a glass-paneled arched door secured by small brass hinges and clasp details on the side. The cabinet has a shallow, open compartment at the bottom containing two small cylindrical objects, one yellow and one brown. The interior and bottom part of the cabinet are depicted in muted green and brown hues, respectively. Below the colored main illustration is a black line sketch of the same cabinet, shown at a three-quarter angle from the rear right side. The sketch shows the cabinet’s contours, fasteners, and back ventilation or decorative cut-out, and is annotated with the name "LADA WILLIAMSON" underneath. The background of the entire drawing is plain beige.
title: Candle Lantern
